rules.common_verbatim: This market will resolve based on which party wins U.S. Senate Rhode Island. Market resolves to "YES" if the winning candidate is affiliated with the specified party, "NO" otherwise. A candidate running on a fusion ticket counts for every party on that ticket, so more than one party's market can resolve "YES" for the same race.
rules.data_source: Official election results from relevant election authorities
rules.certification: Resolution is based on final, certified election results
rules.delay: In case of recounts or legal challenges, resolution may be delayed until final results are certified
rules.discretion: Susquehanna may, at our sole discretion, update the rules, outcomes, or resolution of this market at any time, including after the resolution date or end date.
rules.logical_caveat: Democratic YES and Republican NO generally express the same directional view but are not identical contingent claims. Fusion tickets or non-Democratic/non-Republican winners can differ.
